---
title: "Publications"
bibliography: Flournoy.bib
csl: apa-cv.csl
format:
  html:
    # Quarto builds its TOC from the AST *before* filters run, so the year
    # headings that group-years.lua injects can never appear in it. The filter
    # emits its own year-jump nav instead.
    toc: false
nocite: |
  @*
# Run citeproc ourselves (via citeproc.lua) so the two filters below operate on
# the *rendered* bibliography. Quarto's built-in citeproc would otherwise run
# last, after these filters had nothing to act on.
citeproc: false
filters:
  - citeproc.lua
  - bold-it.lua
  - group-years.lua
---

Peer-reviewed articles, preprints, conference presentations, and my
dissertation, newest first. My name is **bolded** throughout.
